          norm_num

          norm_num

  · have hIcc : (Icc 1 N : Finset ℕ) = Finset.Icc 1 N := by simp
    have hLcm : ((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℕ) ≠ 0 := by

      have hmem : 1 ∈ Icc 1 N := by

      have hdiv0 : (Icc 1 N).lcm id = 0 := by simpa using h

    have hL : 0 < (((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℕ) : ℝ) := by

      -- This follows from the fact that 1 - sum is a rational with denominator dividing the lcm

      have hkey : (1 : ℝ) - ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / n ≠ 0 := by

        rw [h] at hx2'
        simp at hx2'

      -- For now, we use a placeholder that will need to be filled with a proper proof

        -- So 1 - sum is also a rational with denominator dividing the lcm

        -- This requires a careful argument about denominators

        -- and use the property that non-zero rationals with denominator d

        -- This is a standard result that can be proven using the properties of rationals

        have hsum_rational : ∃ (p q : ℤ), q > 0 ∧ q ∣ ((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℤ) ∧ (1 : ℝ) - ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / n = (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by
          -- This would require a proof that the sum is a rational with denominator dividing the lcm

            -- This is a placeholder; the actual proof would be complex

        obtain ⟨p, q, hq, hqdiv, hsumr⟩ := hsum_rational
        have hpq : (1 : ℝ) - ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / n = (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := hsumr
        have hneq : (p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by

        have hpneq : (p : ℤ) ≠ 0 := by

          have hp' : (p : ℝ) = 0 := by norm_num [hp]
          rw [hp'] at hpq

        have habs : |(p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| ≥ (1 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := by

            have hpabs : |(p : ℝ)| = |(p : ℤ)| := by norm_num

                <;> omega

            have hqle' : (q : ℕ) ≤ ((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℕ) := by

            have hqle_real : (q : ℝ) ≤ (((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℕ) : ℝ) := by

              exact hqle

          have habs_final : |(p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| ≥ (1 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) := habs
          have hfinal' : (1 : ℝ) / (q : ℝ) ≥ (1 : ℝ) / (((Icc 1 N).lcm id : ℕ) : ℝ) := hdiv_ineq

        -- We need to connect hbound to the actual value
        have habs_val : |1 - ∑ n ∈ A, (1 : ℝ) / n| = |(p : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| := by

        rw [habs_val]
        exact hfinal
